# The second file of the App folder: one namespace with main.forb, after it.
Total<public>:i64 = Square + Count
Colour<public>:color = Favourite
Double<public>:function<computes>(tuple(i64), i64) = Twice
Doubled<public>:i64 = Double(Total)
# A form of the library block, which follows the last file of the module.
Squares<public>:[]i64 = For(X:array{1, 2, 3}, X * X)

color<public> := enum{red, green}
Favourite<public>:color = color.green
# Base is internal to the Lib folder, declared in base.forb before this file.
Count<public>:i64 = Twice(Base) + 1
